title: 最大方阵和
summary: 可反复选相邻两格同时变号，求最终矩阵元素总和最大值。
insight: 操作保持负数个数奇偶性。若负数为偶数，可把所有数变非负；若为奇数，必须留下一个负数，应选择绝对值最小者。零会让惩罚为零。
pitfalls: 相邻操作足以实现任意符合奇偶性的符号分配

solutions.title: 负号奇偶与最小绝对值
solutions.idea: 累加绝对值并在奇数负号时扣除两倍最小绝对值。
steps: 若 negative 奇数返回 sumAbs-2*minimum，否则 sumAbs

code.java: class Solution { public long maxMatrixSum(int[][] matrix){long sum=0;int negatives=0,minimum=Integer.MAX_VALUE;for(int[] row:matrix)for(int value:row){if(value<0)negatives++;int absolute=Math.abs(value);sum+=absolute;minimum=Math.min(minimum,absolute);}return negatives%2==0?sum:sum-2L*minimum;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxMatrixSum(matrix:Array<IntArray>):Long{var sum=0L;var negatives=0;var minimum=Int.MAX_VALUE;for(row in matrix)for(value in row){if(value<0)negatives++;val absolute=kotlin.math.abs(value);sum+=absolute;minimum=minOf(minimum,absolute)};return if(negatives%2==0)sum else sum-2L*minimum} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: long long maxMatrixSum(vector<vector<int>>& matrix){long long sum=0;int negatives=0,minimum=INT_MAX;for(auto& row:matrix)for(int value:row){negatives+=value<0;int absolute=abs(value);sum+=absolute;minimum=min(minimum,absolute);}return negatives%2?sum-2LL*minimum:sum;} };
